senses.gloss: झिल्लरी झिल्लरी, f. = झल्लरी, q. v.

झिल्लि झिल्लि, इस्, f. a cricket; a kind of
musical instrument; membrane or parchment; [cf.
झिल्ली; cf. also Lat. gryllus; Germ. Grille.]

झिल्ली, f. a cricket; the wick of a lamp; a cloth
or rag for applying unguents, colour, &c.; sunshine,
light, lustre; rice burnt by cooking in a saucepan, &c.;
a musical instrument, cymbals; parchment.
—झिल्ली-
कण्ठ, अस्, m. a domestic pigeon.

झिल्लिका, f. a cricket; a cricket's cry; the light of
sunshine, strong light, splendor; the dirt which
comes from the body in rubbing it with perfumes;
a cloth or rag used for applying colour, unguents,
&c.; a kind of skin or membrane, parchment.
—झिल्लिका-गण-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, resounding
with a multitude of crickets.

झिल्लीक, अस्, m. a cricket; (आ), f. a cricket; sun-
shine; dirt taken off the body in rubbing it with
perfumes.
झिल्लिन् झिल्लिन्, ई, m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi.
